Over one million tonnes of hydrogen cyanide, $\text{HCN}$, are produced each year using the Andrussow process. The overall equation for the reaction is shown.

$$\text{CH}_4\text{(g)} + \text{NH}_3\text{(g)} + 1\frac{1}{2}\text{O}_2\text{(g)} \rightleftharpoons \text{HCN}\text{(g)} + 3\text{H}_2\text{O}\text{(g)}$$

parts.label: (a)(i)
parts.text: Draw a dot-and-cross diagram to represent the bonding in a molecule of ammonia, $\text{NH}_3$, and state the shape of the molecule.

parts.stem: The reaction exists as a dynamic equilibrium.
parts.text: Explain what is meant by the term dynamic equilibrium.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text: State and explain how the amounts of the chemicals present in the equilibrium mixture will change when the pressure is increased.

parts.stem: The reaction of hydrogen cyanide with propanone is an important first step in many organic syntheses.
parts.text: Give the full name of the mechanism of this reaction.

parts.text:
Complete the diagram to show the mechanism of the reaction of hydrogen cyanide with propanone. Draw the structure of the intermediate and the product of the reaction. Include all relevant charges, partial charges, curly arrows and lone pairs.
